# telnyx_10dlc_brand_feedback (Data Source)

The registry's feedback on a 10DLC brand after it was created or revetted, such as a tax ID or stock symbol mismatch, and which submitted fields it concerns.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) ID of the brand being queried about

### Read-Only

- `category` (Attributes List) A list of reasons why brand creation/revetting didn't go as planned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--category))

<a id="nestedatt--category"></a>
### Nested Schema for `category`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Long-form description of the feedback with additional information
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable version of the `id` field
- `fields` (List of String) List of relevant fields in the originally-submitted brand json
- `id` (String) One of `TAX_ID`, `STOCK_SYMBOL`, `GOVERNMENT_ENTITY`, `NONPROFIT`, and `OTHERS`
